h1: Shopify store development, built from scratch
overview: We build a new Shopify store in your own Shopify account, from an empty start to ready for its first order. We set up the theme with your logo and colors, add your products with images and variants, connect payments, shipping and tax, create the core pages and write the search titles. You get a private preview link, a launch checklist and a handover, so you know how to run the store.

faq: Can you build the store if I have nothing yet?

Yes. Tick the box in the order form, give us a store name and tell us what you will sell. We create the store in your own Shopify account and hand it over ready to sell. You can change the name later.
Can you connect my own domain?

Yes. If you already own a domain, we connect it to the new store and set up the redirect from the default Shopify address. If you do not have one yet, we tell you where to buy one and connect it afterwards.
Yes. Choose the dropship option and we import products from your supplier or app. If you have your own products, we add them with your images and variants.
Do I pay for Shopify and apps myself?
Yes. Your Shopify plan and any paid apps are billed by Shopify and the app makers, directly to you. Our price covers the work only.
